create_warp_texture: create a Warp texture from MuJoCo model texture data for GPU rendering
get_rgb: get RGB pixel data from the render context buffers for a given camera index
get_depth: get depth data from the render context buffers for a given camera index with scaling
get_segmentation: get segmentation data from the render context buffers for a given camera index
compute_ray: compute ray direction for a pixel with per-world camera parameters in a Warp kernel
